name: @w6w-apps/semrush
description: Read SEMrush backlink, referring-domain, anchor, competitor and keyword reports, and check the account's remaining API units.

w6w.longDescription:
SEMrush is an SEO and marketing-analytics platform. This app reads its current v4 Standard API (api.semrush.com/apis/v4): a domain's backlink profile — totals, historical summaries, individual links, referring domains and IPs, linked pages, anchors, the domain-score distribution and competitors — plus a keyword's volume, difficulty and SERP features.

SEMrush meters these calls in paid 'API units', so the app also reads the account's remaining balance from the one endpoint that costs nothing (www.semrush.com/users/countapiunits.html). That endpoint is also the credential probe, and it has a trap the app is built around: its error text echoes the submitted key back, so no vendor error string from it is ever surfaced.
